title: Yummy Charred Syrian Shrimp Tagine
description: A brunch‑styled Syrian shrimp tagine that balances smoky char with sweet candied ginger, perfect for a quick, paleo‑friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat a cast‑iron skillet over high heat for 4 minutes.
While the skillet warms, toss the shrimp with lemon juice, smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, pepper, and a splash of olive oil.
Place the shrimp in the hot skillet and sear for 1 minute per side until they develop a dark char and turn opaque.
Remove the shrimp and set aside on a plate.
Reduce the skillet heat to medium and drizzle a tablespoon of olive oil, then add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp to the skillet, sprinkle with cayenne pepper flakes, and stir for another minute to blend the flavors.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro and candied ginger over the shrimp, then give everything a quick toss to coat.
Plate the shrimp on a serving dish, drizzle with a bit more olive oil, and serve immediately for a brunch‑style charred tagine.
